description: Defines the StreamTrigger class which encapsulates timestamps and logic for triggering data streams, including scheduling and rescheduling stream start times.

classes.name: StreamTrigger
classes.description: Represents timestamps and methods for scheduling and managing stream triggers, including creation and rescheduling logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new StreamTrigger instance with specified query start, query end, and planned stream start times.

methods.name: getPlannedStreamStart
methods.description: Returns the planned start timestamp of the stream.

methods.name: getQueryEnd
methods.description: Returns the maximum creation time of entities to be queried.

methods.name: getQueryStart
methods.description: Returns the minimum creation time of entities to be queried.

methods.name: rescheduleAt
methods.description: Returns a new StreamTrigger with the same query start and end but a new planned stream start time.

methods.name: calculateStreamTrigger
methods.description: Calculates a StreamTrigger based on current time, query start, start offset, and stream interval.
